subject: Discovery recap + a quick fit question
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rebecca Nolan <rebecca@novaverse.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-07-09T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap + a quick fit question

Hi Rebecca —

Great to meet you and the Novaverse team earlier today. Quick recap from our side and one clarifying question so we don't spin in circles: 

Key takeaways from the call:
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + retrieval for knowledge base search across product docs (~300k docs).
- Volume profile: peak concurrency ~40 req/s, average 300–400k tokens/day.
- Constraints: data residency preference for US region; SOC 2 evidence required for procurement.
- Success metric: reduce average resolution time by ~20% and cut token spend vs current OpenAPI baseline.

Open question: is tightening the SLA/latency to 200ms p50 a hard requirement or a nice-to-have for your first phase? That changes whether we suggest a hosted vs dedicated capacity approach.

Proposed next steps:
1) If it's still a priority this quarter — 30-min tech sync with Ben to walk traffic patterns and sample prompts (I can run a quick perf projection).
2) We can share a short MAA draft and discovery notes (attached) so your security/purchasing team can start an internal review.
3) If this is deprioritized, say the word and we won't follow up aggressively.

Attachments: Discovery_Notes_20250709.pdf (call notes + sample prompts)

Would appreciate a quick reply on the SLA question above and whether you want us to send the MAA to procurement.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

If I don't hear back, I'll check in again next week and then close the thread if this is off the table.

Cheers,

Subject: Friendly last check — fit and timeline?

Rebecca —

Last touch from me this week on this thread. We try not to be that inbox noise, so if this is not a fit or deprioritized, I appreciate a one-line callout and I'll close the loop. If you are still considering, two small asks so we can move forward: 

- Can you confirm whether low-latency (200ms p50) is required for phase 1?
- If yes, would you prefer a short technical pilot (2–3 weeks) or go straight to a Dedicated reserved pool?

Quick options I can do this week — 15-min slots: Wed 7/30 10:00–11:00am PT, Thu 7/31 2:00–3:00pm PT. If neither works, suggest a time and I'll make it happen.

Attached: MAA_draft_v1.pdf (strawman for procurement). If you want me to send the DocuSign link to your procurement contact, tell me who that is and I’ll send it over.

If no response by Friday I'll assume this is not an active priority and we'll touch later.

Thanks again — low effort on your side to say "not now" or pick a slot.

Best,
Karthik

--

From: Rebecca Nolan <rebecca@novaverse.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-07-23T09:15:00-07:00

Hi Karthik —

Apologies for the slow reply — been heads-down with a Q3 launch. Quick answers: 

- The 200ms p50 is a goal but not a hard blocker for phase 1. We can accept higher latency initially if it keeps costs reasonable.
- We would prefer to kick off a short technical pilot (2 weeks) to validate quality and cost before any Dedicated commitment.

Could you send a one-page summary of the pilot plan and an estimated cost band? Also, please send the MAA to our procurement lead (procurement@novaverse.io). If you can propose a 15-min sync, Aug 6 11:00am PT works for me.

Thanks — appreciate the persistence.

Cheers,
Rebecca Nolan
Head of Customer Experience | Novaverse
rebecca@novaverse.io
